parties: Sachin D. Patel (acquirer) / Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited (target)
headline: Sachin D. Patel discloses substantial share acquisition in Gujarat Themis Biosyn under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Sachin D. Patel has filed a SEBI Regulation 10(5) disclosure for a substantial acquisition of shares in Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited. The filing signals a threshold-crossing acquisition requiring mandatory disclosure to the stock exchange and public.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosures mark critical shareholding milestones under the SEBI Takeover Code; the acquirer's identity, acquisition timing and quantum now trigger open-market scrutiny and potential competing bids or regulatory gating.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10(5) requires that when a person acquires shares crossing prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90%, or 100%), a disclosure must be filed with the stock exchange within 2 trading days. Sachin D. Patel's filing with NSE indicates he has crossed one or more such thresholds. The timing (24 June 2026) and the identifiable acquirer suggest this is likely a single-purchaser acquisition in the pharmaceutical/biotech sector, now subject to public scrutiny and potential subsequent takeover obligations.

Imposes immediate disclosure obligations for acquisitions and shareholding changes; requires material announcements.
